title: Descent of a bounded finitely presented flat complex
statement: Let I be a directed set and let (S_i)_{i\in I} be an inverse system of quasi-compact, quasi-separated schemes with affine transition morphisms, where S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) for Noetherian rings R_i, and let S=\varprojlim_i S_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R). Let X_i be a finitely presented S_i-scheme [def-pc-scheme] and write X=X_i\times_{S_i}S. Let G^\bullet be a bounded complex of finitely presented \mathcal{O}_X-modules flat over S [def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-pc-base-change]. Then there are j\geq i and a bounded complex G_j^\bullet of finitely presented \mathcal{O}_{X_j}-modules flat over S_j, where X_j=X_i\times_{S_i}S_j, together with an isomorphism from its base change to G^\bullet.

proof.text: Infer quasicoherence from finite presentation and apply exists_finitelyPresented_complex_of_limit to obtain a fixed bounded finite-presentation model H at j and compatible termwise limit isomorphisms.

Use flatOver_of_iso from PullbackModelFlatnessComparison to transfer each limit flatness test along its termwise module isomorphism. Apply exists_eventually_isFlatOver_staged_module to each fixed term. On the finite interval Icc a b choose one common upper stage k by finite induction and directedness. Outside the interval tensor pullback preserves zero modules and zero modules are flat.

Apply exists_bounded_complex_baseChange_enlargement to the fixed H and stage maps k -> j and S -> k. Transfer termwise flatness using its term identifications. The cone equation identifies the composite stage map with S -> j. Compose the enlargement comparison, this functor equality isomorphism, and the original limit comparison. Naturality and associativity prove compatibility with every differential.
